name: Ayşe Demir
bio:
Ayşe's journey into motorsport began unconventionally, stemming from a childhood fascination with aircraft design and fluid dynamics. She pursued a degree in aerospace engineering, initially intending to work in the aviation sector. However, a university project involving wind tunnel testing for a student-built Formula SAE car ignited a passion for racing aerodynamics. After graduation, she transitioned to motorsport, starting as a junior technician before specializing in wind tunnel operations.

At EVO Racing Team, Ayşe is known for her meticulous approach and ability to identify subtle aerodynamic improvements. She believes in a data-driven methodology, constantly seeking to refine testing procedures and extract maximum value from each wind tunnel run. Her colleagues appreciate her dedication and willingness to share her knowledge, making her a valuable asset to the team. Ayşe's innovative spirit constantly pushes her to explore new testing techniques and unconventional solutions, giving EVO Racing Team a competitive edge.

physical.hairStyle: Long, wavy hair often pulled back into a practical ponytail during work hours.
physical.description: Ayşe has a focused gaze and a practical, no-nonsense demeanor about her.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with aerodynamic sketches and calculations.
Has a habit of tapping her pen against her teeth when deep in thought.
Insists on listening to Turkish folk music during data analysis to help her concentrate.
